name: Yu Yu Hakusho
summary: A delinquent teenager is killed and gets resurrected to serve as an investigator of the supernatural.

name: Miss Spider's Sunny Patch Friends
summary: Miss Spider's Sunny Patch Friends follows the everyday adventures of a family of bugs, who have made their home in what is called the Hollow Tree, led by the gentle, kind-hearted Miss Spider.

name: Follow Your Heart
summary: The drama portrays the destined romantic tale of the cold and aloof Prince Jiang Xinbai (played by Luo Yunxi), who suffers from prosopagnosia, and the spirited female physician Yan Nanxing (played by Song Yi), who transforms each month. Together, they embark on a journey through love and adventure, uncovering their fated bond in the martial world. The story also follows their strong and solitary characters as they overcome numerous obstacles to uphold justice, offering viewers a glimpse into the true essence of love. While external appearances matter, this drama underscores the importance of a heart-to-heart connection. Love isn't about possession or conquest; being "captivated by love" isn't merely focused on superficial attributes. True love transcends appearances, social status, grudges, and other external factors. It perseveres in pursuing justice and willingly assumes a lifelong responsibility for that love, even extending to safeguarding the world.

name: RuPaul's Drag Race Live Untucked
summary: RuPaul's Drag Race Live Untucked will take you to Sin City to catch ALL the behind-the-scenes tea from RuPaul's Drag Race Live!

previousepisode.name: Tänk om ingen gillar nya mig

name: 007: Road to a Million
summary: From the Hollywood producers behind the James Bond movies comes 007: Road to a Million. Nine pairs of everyday people are unleashed on an epic global adventure through a series of Bond inspired challenges, for a shot at winning a life-changing £1,000,000 prize. The Controller is the mastermind behind the game, watching the pairs as they hunt for 10 questions he's hidden around the world

name: Lost Women of Highway 20
summary: Lost Women of Highway 20 is a sprawling, true-crime odyssey that begins with the disappearance of a 13-year-old Rachanda Pickle. When Rachanda disappears in 1990, detectives discover a trail of missing and murdered women along a ghostly stretch of Oregon's US Highway 20 that goes back for decades, leading them to a killer who has been hiding in plain sight. With narration from Spencer, Lost Women of Highway 20 is a gripping documentary that asks poignant questions of our society's treatment of women - then and now.

name: FEDS
summary: FEDS will take viewers deep inside America's most elite crime-fighting agency, the FBI. The series, through gripping interviews with active-duty FBI agents, will detail high-profile, dangerous, and unusual cases with added insight from informants, undercover operatives, and victims. Offering unparalleled perspective, Feds reveals the twists and turns of each case, as agents let their guard down and for the first time, bring us into their private world. Showcasing a variety of investigations - from infiltrating MS-13 in Boston to taking down a multimillion-dollar drug empire in Florida - Feds shows the lengths the FBI goes to protect citizens across the country. In the season premiere, FBI special agents Wayne Jackowski and Andy Kehren recount an investigation into a terrifying kidnapping of a couple that results in a heart-pounding car chase with the prime suspect.

name: Deane's Dynasty
summary: Celebrity power couple Lydia and Matthew Deane and their famous friends navigate the ups and downs of fame, family and career in bustling Bangkok.

name: Linlang
summary: Victor "Bangis" Lualhati has always been a fighter. As a former boxer, he gets used to overcoming obstacles through tough times. However, when he finds a suspicious message on his wife's phone, he will be faced with a challenge he never saw coming. As Victor investigates, he discovers there is more at play than just a cheating spouse. The deeper he digs, the more shocking realizations he makes.

name: Treasure at Dawn
summary: Hua Fusheng is a young man who's innocent and obsessed with medicine. He uses unconventional methods that both endear and frighten the townspeople. He is wrongly accused of murder after the death of Bai Yi. Clues left behind by his mentor seem to point to a mysterious "Sacred Book." At the same time, Wen Jue, the daughter of Liangzhou city lord, and Gu Tian, an inheritor of the performing arts, get drawn into the mystery. The three of them head to Liangzhou to investigate. Wen Jue uses her family's influence to help Hua Fusheng open a clinic, while Gu Tian's quick wit aids them in gathering intel. As Hua Fusheng heals the poor, he hunts for the truth, but strange events unfold, and the puzzle deepens. Unknown to him, his arrival has already stirred hidden forces in Liangzhou...

name: Pocket ni Boken wo Tsumekonde
summary:
Madoka Akagi grew up in a port town in the Kanto prefecture of Japan. After graduating university, she moved to work at ADventure, a small advertising agency in Tokyo. She came to Tokyo in search of her dreams but reality sets in and every day is not like the world she imagined, especially when she has to do a presentation that decides the company's fate. However, she soon finds a package from her mother which includes a Game Boy Pocket and Pokémon Red. 

She decides to start playing Pokémon Red for the first time in 20 years. How will her adventure go?

name: BEYBLADE X
summary: The story revolves around a young boy named Bird Kazami who aims to be a professional Beyblader. He aims to get into the Pro League held in the X Tower, where professional Beybladers gather.

name: Zarqa
summary: A divorced, middle-aged Muslim woman strives to reinvent herself… until her impulsive and vindictive personality gets in the way.

name: Chloe Madeley: A Family Affair
summary: Chloe Madeley opens the door to her life as she juggles work, first-time motherhood, and her famous family.

name: Last Exit Schinkenstraße
summary: Two awkward men in their mid-50s, trumpeter Torben  and saxophonist Peter, are unceremoniously fired by the leader of their dance band Boarding Time. What now? At a jam session someone comes up with an idea: Peter and Torben should go to Mallorca and become Schlager stars in El Arenal. The road to stardom is however paved with complications like song theft, holiday romance and Torben's suspicious wife Ilona.

name: Paranormal Revenge
summary: Each hour explores two chilling stories of real-life paranormal encounters that intersect with revenge.

name: Find My Beach House
summary: A couple are looking to relocate from the city to an Australian seaside location. Host Shelley Craft shows them through three houses that suit their speciﬁc brief.

name: JFK: One Day in America
summary: President Kennedy is shot in broad daylight while visiting Dallas.

name: Hail to the Princess
summary: The country of Liulian, where women are honored, was in trouble both internally and externally. The Chief Advisor said, "If the sixth daughter are born, the world will die." But General Gu gave birth to the sixth daughters. In order to save the youngest daughter, the Gu family falsely claimed to have a son. Her daughter Gu Rong was old enough to get married, so she disguised herself as a man and took her childhood sweetheart Shen Mengchui with her to marry her "good sister", Princess Yun. Since then, the trios had joined forces to start the battle for the throne.

name: Miss Mystery
summary: Xue Tong, the daughter of a wealthy family, witnessed her entire family being massacred in her childhood. Eighteen years later, Xue Tong returned to her hometown under the alias Lin Bao'er and hatched an elaborate plan to eliminate the murderers of her family. However, her plans were disrupted by an engagement, and she unexpectedly became the fiancée of Zhu Guanwen, the son of her enemies... Under the disguise of skilled flirtation, who would emerge victorious in this game ?

name: CRUSH
summary: CRUSH is a spine-tingling account of what happened when a Halloween night of celebration turned into a nightmare. More than 100,000 young revelers, who were packed into the narrow bar-lined alleyways of Seoul's trendy Itaewon neighborhood, became trapped in a mass panic. The toll was astonishing: 159 people, including two American students studying abroad, had suffocated and died that night. Nearly all those who perished were in their twenties.

name: The Inextricable Destiny
summary: Hei Jiuling, the daughter of a patriotic general, goes to great lengths to break off her engagement with Rong Yu, the young master of the Astrological Pavilion. Using all her tricks, she disguises herself as a dandy and acts like a tyrant. However, a moment of carelessness turns the object of every girl's dream into a childlike innocence. Amidst their tumultuous and comical encounters, an unexpected affection quietly blossoms. Meanwhile, a plot involving noble families, the royal court, and the Astrological Pavilion begins to unfold.

name: Перепой звезду!
summary:
A music show where ordinary people challenge professionals and prove they can sing better! Each episode features eight hits, eight stars, and eight amateurs, including dentists, mechanics, painters, salespeople, hairdressers, postmen, teachers, and representatives of many other professions.
"Sing a Star!" features live sound only. According to the show's rules, the non-professional performer begins the first verse, then the star performs, and they perform a duet at the end. The contestant and star will only see each other for the first time on stage. It's impossible to guess the artist from the song, as they all sing hits they haven't composed themselves. The star's appearance is always a surprise (or even a shock) for the non-professional. The key is to stay alert.

name: Buta no Liver wa Kanetsu Shiro
summary: An unappealing otaku awakens in the body of a pig after he passes out while eating raw pig liver. The pig finds himself in the company of Jess, an innocent girl who can read people's minds, and she accepts him despite his boorish thoughts... although she does plan to eat him. When Jess is in danger of succumbing to a dark destiny, can Pig save her using only his quick wits, wisdom, and refined sense of smell?

name: Iyashi no Otonari-san ni wa Himitsu ga aru
Langt fra Bryggen
summary: We follow Stephanie and Cengiz, who have bought a house in Amager, which they have to renovate in seven months, while they live in the conversion - but it's not easy to live in construction mess and craftsman noise with two children.

name: Sæt pris på Danmark
summary: Hans Pilgaard invites two well-known Danes to a region where they have to guess prices for experiences.

name: Olhos da Lei
summary: For the first time, a television crew is authorized to record inside the São Paulo Military Police Operations Center (COPOM). COPOM is the largest police operations center in the southern hemisphere. With technology, intelligence and images from body cameras, a troop of 1200 agents responds to 30,000 requests for help that arrive daily via 190. All under the Eye of the Law.

name: Power of Hope: Precure Full Bloom
summary: One of the anime projects to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the Precure franchise, this sequel will show Nozomi Yumehara and other characters from Yes! Precure 5 and Yes! Precure 5 GoGo! as grown-ups.

name: Super Dinosaur
summary: Leaping from the pages of the Skybound/Image comic book series by Robert Kirkman and Jason Howard, 'Super Dinosaur' stars 10 year old Derek Dynamo and his best-friend Super Dinosaur, a genetically engineered T-Rex with human-level intelligence and an aptitude for awesome combat gear. The fate of the world rests on the shoulders of the dynamic duo as the team up for epic crime-fighting adventures.

name: The IDOLM@STER Million Live!
summary: Spun off from The Idolm@ster, this series follows a new group of idols working alongside the thirty-nine idols of the newly-formed 765PRO Live Theater base at 765 Productions and a producer at the 765 Theater Agency.

name: Surviving Amber Heard
summary: This 2-part docu-series takes us inside the Johnny Depp and Amber Heard tumultuous marriage. It examines the events, evidence and the characters that surrounded that relationship.

name: Lolita Lolita
summary: Lolita, a young fine impish girl, evolves in an every day-life background. In spite of herself, her charms provoke strange or even surrealistic reactions in people and objects.

name: Mikrobi
summary: Mikrobi is a robot that has three eyes, a stretchy neck and takes care of the three children traveling across the cosmos.

name: CNN News Central (PM)
summary: News from around the world with Brianna Keilar and Boris Sanchez.

name: The Money List
summary: Baz Ashmawy hosts the quiz where teams of strangers compete to fill in missing answers on a list for the chance to win €15,000.

name: Hålla Samman
summary: Keep It Together is a returning drama series about 40-year-old nurse Lina Edin and her life in small town Sweden. Lina works at the E.R. and lives alone with her 14-year-old twins Molly and Melvin. Lina's two years older sister Petra lives close by with her family. When their father Kenneth is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, life changes drastically for both sisters; starting with Kenneth moving in to Lina's house.

name: Blossom with Love
summary: The process of sharing feelings that may be love between a boy and a girl who are awkward because it is their first time and face more exciting and vivid moments because they are clumsy.

name: Andarnas Rike
summary: Spirits, crystals, secret societies and witches are more relevant than ever. A large part of Swedes, especially the young, believe that life in some form continues after death and that many people have paranormal abilities. How is that possible in the world's most secularized country?

name: Historien om Sverige
summary: The great story of our country. About the people and forces that shaped it - from the Ice Age to the present day. Simon J Berger is the narrator of the series. The program series consists of ten parts and is based on reconstructions of historical events and people. Over 300 experts have contributed to the content and 100 of them appear in the series. The leitmotif for the series is composed by Ludwig Göransson and Per-Gunnar Juliusson.

previousepisode.name: Världens modernaste land, år 1921 till våra dagar

name: Den Svenska Tinderbedragaren
summary: The Swedish Tinder fraudster is a documentary series about a number of women who have one thing in common, they all testify that they have been deceived by the same man. After he has built up trust over time with the women through his charm and attractive lifestyle, he makes irresistible offers of employment, investment, partnership and other effective cuts.

name: Skam dig, kvinde!
summary: This two-part series, focuses on the lack of women rights to abortion in the Faroe Islands, that yet being part of the Danish Kingdom, does not have the same rights as the rest of Denmark.

name: Der Fall Jens Söring - Tödliche Leidenschaft
summary: Did Jens Soering murder his girlfriend's parents in 1985 — or was she the killer? This docuseries digs into questions that still swirl around the case.

name: Love Me, Love My Voice
summary: The story revolves around Gu Sheng, a music-loving senior college student who perseveres in pursuing her dreams while silently maintaining another hidden identity as a low-profile figure in the traditional music circle known as "Sheng Sheng Man". She yearns for an opportunity to collaborate with her crush, a renowned figure in the voice-acting community called "Qiang Qing Ci". By a stroke of serendipity, she crosses paths with Mo Qingcheng, who is actually "Qiang Qing Ci", during an event. With the help of Gu's best friend, their distance gradually closes. Subsequently, Mo Qingcheng uses delectable cuisine and his captivating voice, slowly initiating a plan to win her heart. By the time Gu Sheng realizes it, she has already fallen into the sweet trap set by Mo Qingcheng.

name: Great Performances Dance in America
summary: Aspects of the art form in America.

name: A Bloody Lucky Day
summary: A Bloody Lucky Day is a thriller series about an ordinary taxi driver Oh Taek carrying a guest to Mokpo, who offers a high price, and then realizing that he is a serial killer and starts a horror drive.

previousepisode.name: What though Life Conspires to Cheat You

name: Gabrielle Union: My Journey to 50
summary: Gabrielle Union turns 50 and embarks on an adventure through Africa where she gets in touch with her roots and experiences the birthday bash of a lifetime with her loved ones.

name: Ilhados com a Sogra
summary: To win a life-changing prize, couples embark on a journey to an earthly paradise and confront challenges... with the assistance of their mothers-in-law.

name: Toki wo Kakeruna, Koibitotachi
summary: Tokiwa Megu is a modern-era woman who excels at work but cannot succeed where romance is concerned. By chance, she meets Iura Kakeru, a member of the time patrol team who comes from the future and together they receive a special mission where they are tasked to catch illegal time travelers. Although the two were former lovers, Megu's memory of their time together has been erased in accordance with the time traveling governing rules. In order to make her relationship come to fruition this time, Megu spends time struggling to find the love of her life.

name: Moses the Lawgiver
summary: A biopic of Moses, who led the Jewish people out of Egypt, ex. by parting the Red Sea and afterwards delivered the Ten Commandments from God.

name: From Hong Kong to Beijing
summary: Tsui Gong-Yan, a senior executive of a property management company, took advantage of luck and his career was going smoothly. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong accidentally fell into an investment scam and suffered heavy losses. Gong-Yan was assigned to the Beijing branch as CEO, and saw this as an opportunity to turn around, so he and Helen went north to develop, but unexpectedly they encountered a mid-life crisis. Gong-Yan was forced to stay behind for the sake of face due to the rise and fall of his old enemy Ding Chi-Keung. He later met Sophie, whom he had not seen for many years, and his marriage faced a test. Food internet celebrity Tsui Gong-Man and street singer Tsui Bo-Yi each have their own reasons for moving north to join their eldest brother Gong-Yan. The family brainstorms and plans to transform an abandoned transformer factory into a cultural and creative park. Hong Kong people who are "Buddhist" must seriously fight a tough battle in life!

name: Big Brother
summary: Housemates live under 24-hour surveillance as they attempt to avoid eviction from the Big Brother house with the most unpopular housemates facing a public vote. The iconic house has had a fresh lick of paint and is ready to welcome a brand-new cast of housemates from all walks of life as they take up residence in the Big Brother house, so join hosts AJ Odudu and Will Best for all of the action from their first week there!

name: Blev vores datter myrdet?
summary: Three part serie, that investigates the death of 'Henriette', which was found dead after a party trip with her friends to the town. Police thinks she commited suicide, while her parents and leading experts express that this cannot be the case.

name: Deadly Honeymoons
summary: Dream weddings turns into disasters.

name: Secret Bunkers
summary: Bunkers are found in many regions of Europe, reflecting the technical know-how and threats of their particular eras. A look at how military protective structures are more than technical systems.

name: 7 Days Before Valentine
summary: Sunshine is a rising model and actor whose love life is plummeting fast. On the very day he was trying to decide what to do with his life, fate sent someone with special powers to restore his previous relationship within 7 days. However, nothing is this world is free. Everyone must pay something in return and that person is teaching him a very expensive lesson.

name: The Prisoner of Beauty
summary:
A retreat on the battlefield orchestrated by Xiaoqiao's grandfather fourteen years ago resulted in the deaths of Wei family elders, igniting a bitter clan feud. Now, Wei Shao, the sole Wei survivor, marches on Yanzhou, ostensibly for revenge but truly to restore the vital Yongning Canal. Seeing through his plan, Xiaoqiao agrees to a strategic marriage to ease the crisis.

Initially at odds, the couple slowly bonds through shared trials. As old grudges fade, love grows. Together, they overcome adversity and fight for peace, ultimately becoming lifelong companions.

name: The Real Murders of Los Angeles
summary: Encompassing everything from beach communities like Venice and Malibu to the wealth of Beverly Hills and hip enclaves like Thai Town and Highland Park, The Real Murders of Los Angeles exposes the dark underbelly of the city's glamorous façade

name: Life Today with James Robison
summary: James Robison is a former preacher who changed directions in his life several years ago and began hosting this television show alongside his wife, Betty, in order to reach out to help more people.

name: Sid Roth's It's Supernatural
summary: Messianic investigator Sid Roth discusses and examines the supernatural reality and power of God.

name: Grab Your Catechism with Fr. Connor
summary: The first two parts of the Catholic Catechism examine the questions of Faith and Revelation.

name: Yong An Dream
summary: Yong'an, the capital city, fell into chaos due to the collapse of the West Canal. Shen Wenqi, the Minister of Works in charge of the construction, was implicated overnight and thrown into prison. "When the nest is overturned, no egg remains intact." Shen Wenqi's two daughters, Shen Ran and Shen Zhen, found themselves trapped in a dilemma one after another. Especially Shen Zhen, the youngest daughter, who had always been sheltered in seclusion and was ignorant of the world, now struggled to fend for herself on the streets. During this time, Lu Shiyan, the imperial prosecutor responsible for investigating the case, was perplexed by recurring dreams of his entanglement with a mysterious woman. After verification, he discovered that the mysterious woman in his dreams was Shen Zhen, the daughter of the guilty official. Lu Shiyan gradually approached her, stepping into an unknown fate. As they delved into the West Canal case, they experienced life and death, entrusted each other with faith, and developed a deep affection. With Shen Zhen's help, Lu Shiyan uncovered the truth behind the case. However, the true mastermind was silently closing in on the two of them.

name: Саша против!
summary: Sasha, a 17-year-old Muscovite, finds out that her mother is going to remarry, and she will have a stepbrother Mamazhan. Peaceful coexistence is quickly under threat: Sasha is biased against the Genre and prevents him from making music, and Jean considers Sasha an arrogant kid and hinders her sports career in every possible way. Wanting to get rid of each other, teenagers enter into a confrontation that leads to unexpected consequences for both.

name: Sakla Beni
summary: Mete and Naz are the favorite children of rich and powerful families. Both of them are spoiled and used to getting everything they want in life. Their story, which started with the promise of their families in their childhood, flows towards marriage today with their inability to break away from each other. But when Naz's maid İncila, who has been with him since childhood, suddenly appears in front of Mete, Mete questions all the decisions he has made in life. Will this encounter between İncila and Mete change the direction of the story Naz wrote with all her stubbornness and help Mete find true love?

name: Sword and Fairy 1
summary: Li Xiaoyao, a young inn attendant who dreams of becoming a great hero, accidentally meets Zhao Ling'er, a descendant of the goddess Nuwa. Together, they embark on a quest to find the Water Spiritual Bead, which can end the drought plaguing the land. Along the way, they befriend the bickering partner Lin Yueru and the scholarly Liu Jinyuan, among other like-minded companions. They face numerous dangers in their search for the spiritual bead and ultimately thwart the cataclysmic scheme of the Moon Worship Sect's leader, who aims to destroy the world.

name: Ripe Town
summary: In the 37th year of Wanli reign of the Ming Dynasty, murders occurred one after another in gunu County, Jiangnan. The dead had different identities and had nothing to do with each other. The bodies were arranged in strange postures. A sentence was left at each scene of the crime. As the apprentice of the first victim, the little Constable Qu Sangen cooperated with his little partner to carry out an investigation. With the deepening of the investigation, people from all walks of life, farmers, businessmen and so on came to the scene. In the fog, an old case ten years ago surfaced. Who is the murderer and what is his purpose?

name: A Nation of Kimchi
summary: Embark on a gastronomic adventure of kimchi and discover what makes it Korea's most symbolic food of unity, history and ever-evolving creativity

name: The Shadow
summary: It tells the story of Shen Zhiheng, a gentleman and celebrity in the Republic of China, and Mi Lan, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, who has been blind since childhood. They met on a fateful night when Mi Lan accidentally got a moment of vision, thus finding out Shen Zhiheng's secret of his immortality. From then on they have been tied to each other and redeemed each other ever since.

name: The Blossoming Love
summary: In ancient times, Emperor Zhaoming selflessly sacrificed himself to battle the divine realm, striving to save his people. Upon his fall, his beloved, Hun Dunzhu, risked everything to rescue a fragment of his soul, initiating an eternal cycle of reincarnation. Millennia later, Zhaoming is reborn as Xie Xuechen, the esteemed leader of the Celestial Alliance, while Hun Dunzhu returns as Mu Xuanling, the revered saintess of the Dark Domain. Reunited in the mortal world, they have no memory of their past lives and stand as sworn enemies embodying good and evil. When Mu Xuanling saves a gravely injured Xie Xuechen within the Dark Domain, she forces him to accompany her, leveraging a life debt. As they journey together, their initial distrust and hidden agendas give way to mutual respect and unspoken emotions. Amidst their evolving relationship, a dark conspiracy surrounding the legendary Chaos Pearl thrusts them into a series of life-and-death trials. In a moment of ultimate sacrifice, Mu Xuanling gives her life to save the world. Determined to defy fate, Xie Xuechen alters destiny itself, traveling back in time to rescue her. With the cycle of countless lifetimes finally broken, Xie Xuechen reclaims his true identity as Emperor Zhaoming. However, his original form has been transformed into a Fallen God. Mu Xuanling's enduring love redeems the Fallen God, averting the impending apocalypse and restoring peace to the realm.

name: Crimefeed
summary: Each week, Crimefeed will delve into key, true crime stories as they unfold, bringing the audience breaking news updates in cases at the forefront of headlines across the globe. Grace, award-winning journalist Mara S. Campo and former police sergeant and private investigator Derrick Levasseur will lend their extensive knowledge and expertise as they evaluate each story, weighing in on everything from the legal and police proceedings to the forensics in the investigation. Grace, Campo and Levasseur will also be joined by a variety of guests such as investigators, survivors, true crime experts, attorneys and law enforcement throughout each segment.

name: The Story of Park's Marriage Contract
summary: A time-slip romance drama about the contractual marriage between bachelor Kang Tae Ha and Park Yun Woo, who has traveled to modern day from 19th century Joseon.

name: Min ødelagte hjerne
summary: This documentary serie follows a series of brain injured Danes. They survived, but the costs have big consequences for them. The serie follows multiple ppl that is suffering from brain injury; What to do when all that before was easy and normal, now has become incredible complicated if not impossible?d normal, now has become incredible complicated if not impossible?

name: Hoshikuzu Telepath
summary: Konohoshi Umika is a high-schooler who is very bad at communicating with others. Feeling almost like an alien trapped on Earth with nowhere to belong, one day she meets a girl who claims to be an actual alien!

name: Will Love in Spring
summary: Chen Maidong, once a rebellious youth, chooses to become a mortician after experiencing a life-changing event. Zhuang Jie, who becomes disabled due to a car accident, strives for a better life and becomes a successful professional in a big city. This drama portrays the journey of them who, despite their contrasting personalities and circumstances, learn to understand and accept one another. Their love heals their hearts, allowing them to embrace and appreciate their "imperfect" selves.

name: Losmen Melati
summary: Starting from the intriguing ending of the film version, this series delves deeper into the terrifying secrets within this enigmatic inn. When guests arrive to witness the peculiar and mysterious Melati Inn, its owner, Madam Melati, has her own plans for the souls entering her cursed motel. Amidst the rising fear, we soon uncover Melati's secret, her history of torment, and her connection to this inn.

name: Love Has Fireworks
summary: Qian Fei, a junior investment banking employee, had her life carefully planned out and believed she was on the path to happiness. But her world is turned upside down when her fiancé, Wang Ruohai, decides to leave her. Forced to start over, Qian Fei embarks on a challenging journey to rebuild both her life and career. Li Yifei, a wealthy heir determined to make a name for himself through hard work, sees love as a bonus rather than a necessity. His girlfriend, Gui Lili, is unwilling to endure the hardships of a startup lifestyle and leaves him behind. Through an unexpected twist of fate, Qian Fei and Li Yifei, who hold completely different views on life and love, find their paths crossing. To keep up with her mortgage payments, Qian Fei rents out a room to Li Yifei, and the two begin an unlikely co living arrangement. Surrounded by the support of friends, family, and colleagues, Qian Fei faces challenges and conflicts head on. With resilience, determination, and an unwillingness to give up, she gradually grows into a stronger and more confident person. As Qian Fei and Li Yifei go from roommates to project partners, their constant clashes and misunderstandings slowly give way to mutual understanding. In time, they fall in love and choose to face the future side by side.

name: Отмороженные
summary: Four bandits in the late nineties come to knock money out of the debtor, but accidentally fall into the cryocamera — and end up in 2022. Phil, Chuck, Whizz and the Mass do not immediately realize that during this time Moscow has radically changed, their lifestyle has become very outdated, and people around have a lot of unfamiliar devices and strange habits. The worst thing is that their loved ones have grown older, and now someone will have to rebuild a relationship with their son, who has become his age, and someone will have to win the heart of an already much-matured girlfriend. Now the four friends must find themselves in a new incomprehensible world and take revenge on the former boss, who sent them to the cryocamera.

name: Take 5 with Zan Rowe
summary: You can learn a lot about someone from their mixtape. Icons in music and screen join Zan Rowe to delve deep into intimate moments in their lives, sharing songs that have made them who they are today.

name: Mysteries of the Faith
summary: Unexplainable healing. Portents of disaster. Can holy artifacts perform miracles? Listen to the passionate stories of faithful followers who believe so.

name: Fletcher's Family Farm
summary: Join former Emmerdale and Strictly star, actor and first-time farmer Kelvin Fletcher, his wife, actress and model Liz and their four children, as they open their home and hearts to share an intimate insight into their rural life.

name: Pod Save the World
summary: Like most people, Pod Save America cohost Tommy Vietor thought foreign policy was boring and complicated until he got the education of a lifetime working for President Obama's National Security Council. It was a crash course that taught him two things: anyone can understand these issues, and we all have an obligation to try. That's why he started Pod Save the World—a weekly podcast that breaks down international news and foreign policy developments, but doesn't feel like homework. Each week, he and former deputy national security advisor and co-host Ben Rhodes walk you through the latest developments with a variety of experts and take you behind the scenes of big decisions with the people who were there. Count on hearing stories from the White House Situation Room, funny anecdotes, and maybe a few F bombs along the way.

previousepisode.name: Israel Invades Lebanon, Iran Attacks Israel

name: 4EVER
summary: Young musicians Ian, Andy, Dario, and Ciro meet by chance in a restaurant when a valuable guitar that one of them had borrowed disappears. Together, they must find a way to recover it and return it to its owner. To achieve their goal, they must become a recognized boy band in Miami, barely knowing each other.

name: Amazing Race Suomi
summary: Amazing Race Suomi is a Finnish reality series in which two-person teams, mainly known for their publicity, travel around the globe and complete various challenges.

name: Scent of Time
summary:
A hard-working young woman in the new era wakes up and finds that she has transmigrated into a novel she stayed up reading all night. Fine, what's done is done except she's also in the body of a vicious supporting role.

Now a character in a novel, the modern-day girl has to cope with having a traitor father and a playboy brother. What's worse, "she" has already done all sorts of bad things in the earlier parts of the story, so her intentions to ensure that her character stays alive till the end can only be described as a long and difficult road. Only after experiencing things firsthand does she realize that the heroine can easily capture one's smile without much effort. Let's see how the "vicious" supporting character without the heroine's halo and golden armor turn her pile of bad cards into a winning hand.

name: Tony Robinson's Marvellous Machines
summary:
Sir Tony Robinson travels the world to explore the most unusual and innovative machines and vehicles. In each episode, Tony discovers four truly mind-blowing and unique machines.

Tony will meet the teams who operate them and the amazing engineers, scientists and inventors who created them. Through behind-the-scenes access to the factories and workshops, technical displays and engaging challenges, he'll explore the incredible science and engineering that make these machines tick in fun and exciting ways... and sometimes even get to have a go at operating them himself.

name: Tweedy & Fluff
summary: Tweedy & Fluff is a stop-motion animated series whose big-hearted yarn-made main characters met on the workshop floor of a tweed mill. They quickly become inseparable bond, learning how to communicate without using speech and manage their anxieties in stressful situations. The series explores love, nurture and friendship through visual comedy.

name: Bangers: Mad for Cars
summary: Rapper Tinie and Formula 1 analyst and stunt driver Naomi Schiff go head-to-head in search of the best modern classic cars from the 80s, 90s and 00s to decide... which banger is best?

name: Tea of Destiny
summary: As a heroine in the martial arts world, Jing Qi'er descends from the mountain where her sect is located and comes to Carefree Tea House to find the miracle cure, Rejuvenating Pill, in an attempt to save her 'gravely ill' foster father. There, she meets Huan Yunhua, the master of Yunshan Pavilion. He disguises himself as the long-lost young master of the tea house, aiming to loot it. Both harboring their own secrets, they pretend to be a couple. However, this leads to the unraveling of old grudges and misunderstandings, inadvertently restoring the reputation of the tea house and causing them to fall in love with each other. In the vast martial arts world, joy and happiness are within easy reach for them.

name: -50kg no Cinderella
summary: Hime, who was a college student looking for a job, fell in love at first sight with Osamu, an employee at a company information session. With her single-minded desire to see him again, she succeeds in dieting and gets a job at the company. However, it is discovered that Tsukasa is the son of the company and was attracted to the pre-diet Yangme. The love of Yangme, who sways between her outward appearance and her inner self, and the unpredictable fate of their love are depicted in a series of beautiful, sweet, glittering, heart-pounding scenes. In the play, the eternal theme of women who seek beauty and health, "diet", is also described in detail. It is said that the diet method that can be practiced safely and realistically will be introduced attractively both visually and informationally.

name: My Lovely Wife
summary: Xu Nian, who witnessed her mother's death firsthand, developed mutism due to PTSD, losing her mother's care. Her father marries his lover and brings in a stepdaughter of similar age, subjecting Xu Nian to his cold indifference and the mistreatment and bullying of her stepmother Jiang Wanli and her daughter Xu Yao. However, Xu Nian has always believed that there was a hidden truth behind her mother's death. To uncover the truth, she had to pretend to be weak and innocent, playing the role of a mute girl, while in reality, she is a kind-hearted but highly intelligent woman. Gu Mingyan, a stern and powerful CEO, has a paranoid personality due to childhood traumas, making him deeply suspicious of others. He has long suspected that his father's death was a conspiracy involving the Xu family and Gu Hongyu. Upon discovering Xu Nian's true identity, he seeks to use her to uncover the truth. Gu Mingyan manipulates Xu Nian into signing a marriage contract and "living together" with him, unaware that he is the prey of Xu Nian, a skilled manipulator. In their battle of wits, the two strong individuals move from deceiving each other to genuine emotions. On the path of revenge, they transition from using each other to cooperating against a common enemy. Their hearts gradually draw closer, and they fall in love with each other. However, just as everything seems to be going perfectly, they discover that the true mastermind is far beyond their expectations. The future of their relationship becomes uncertain.

name: Forbrydelser Der Rystede Danmark
summary: This documentary series focuses on the biggest crimes ever commited in Denmark.

name: The Greatest Show Never Made
summary: In 2002 six young people seeking fame and fortune applied for a new, top secret, reality TV show. They left their homes, jobs and partners and travelled to London to start the adventure. Twenty years after their dreams were shattered, they are still searching for answers; trying to understand how a show that didn't exist, and the disappearance of the man behind it, changed their lives forever.

name: Hostage 911
summary: Negotiators record harrowing conversations with criminals who have taken people hostage. In each terrifying standoff, hear their conversations with criminals, and negotiators will break down their psychological tactics. Will the hostages get out alive?

previousepisode.name: My Husbands Coming to Kill Us

name: Alphonse
summary: Alphonse, a quadragenarian going through a professional and marital crisis, reconnects with a father he barely knew and discovers a surprising new calling. Along the way, he meets a galaxy of women, each more exciting and quirkier than the last, plunging him into a journey that is both perilous and transgressive, yet filled with kindness.

name: The Katie Phang Show
summary: Katie Phang explores the intersections of law, politics, culture and more, and features interviews with the nation's top newsmakers.

name: Ghosting with Luke Hutchie and Matthew Finlan
summary:
A new unscripted comedy series, that follows Hutchie and Finlan, two actors known exclusively for their work in the horror genre, as they step off script and into their own real-life thriller on their quest to decipher if Canada's most haunted places are truly haunted.

In each episode, the amateur ghost-wrangling duo are joined by celebrity guests, to meet locals who claim to have experienced a real-life haunting. While investigating the renowned site, they see if it lives up to the local ghost lore as they work to reach a verdict of "haunted" or "not" alongside their celebrity guest.

name: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
summary: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius with an A-list cast of actors, including Dame Judi Dench, Dame Helen Mirren, Brian Cox, Adrian Lester, Lolita Chakrabarti, Martin Freeman and Jessie Buckley, alongside academics and writers including James Shapiro and Jeanette Winterson, bringing fresh insights into the story of our greatest writer.  The series is narrated by Juliet Stevenson.

name: Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
summary: London is rocked by terrorist attacks as armed police shoot dead an innocent man on his way to work.

name: Marilyn Manson: Unmasked
summary: In February 2021, Marilyn Manson was accused of sexual assault, leading to his dismissal by his manager, agent, and record company. Marilyn Manson: Unmasked examines the allegations, their impact on his career, and broader industry changes.

name: Red Flag
summary:
Over eight compelling episodes, the stories of people who have been catfished, gaslit and deceived are told through first-person survivor testimony. In each episode, Red Flag explores the experiences of those who have been targeted by digital manipulators who use dating sites, instant messaging and fake personas to prey on and exploit their partners.

Viewers are introduced to a new lexicon of manipulative relationship terms - 'breadcrumbing', 'mirroring' and 'love bombing'. These are weapons available to those perpetrators who are all too ready to manipulate and abuse the individuals they come across.

name: The Garden: Commune or Cult
summary:
An infamous off-grid community that went viral on social media for disturbing allegations is now the subject of a six-part limited series. 

On 22 acres of backcountry land in the American South lies The Garden – a community that lives by its own laws, free from the pressures of modern society. They maintain an open-door policy to anyone seeking to join their ranks, but new people must submit to an initiation period. Some barely last a week, others are forced to leave, and a chosen few will call The Garden home for good. Questions continue to arise about the cult-like vibes of the controversial community, but this spring is different. Cameras have been granted unprecedented access to The Garden, documenting its spread to new locations deep in the Ozarks.

Founded as a cooperative, "leaderless" community, The Garden could be viewed as a post-apocalyptic wonderland free of societal rules. However, when potential members arrive, they quickly realize there's more than meets the eye. New initiates include Tyler, a veteran and self-described doomsday prepper; Tisheila, a truck driver survivalist; "Oak," who wants to toughen up after years behind a desk; and Jessica, a former cheerleader looking to reconnect with nature. 

These newcomers have ten days to prove to The Garden that they have what it takes to be part of the community. Did they join a commune working towards a sustainable, off-grid way of life? Or have they just surrounded themselves with members of a mind-controlling cult?

name: Chopped: Julia Child's Kitchen
summary: Sixteen chefs well-versed in all things Julia Child are ready to put their expertise to the test in the new five-part tournament Chopped: Julia Child's Kitchenhosted by Ted Allen and premiering Tuesday, November 14th at 8pm ET/PT on Food Network. With passion and creativity, the chefs will face off in four preliminary heats for a spot in the finale where they will have the chance to battle it out for the ultimate gastronomes grand prize – a $25,000 Julia Child-themed trip to France. As they attempt to put an innovative and modern spin on Julia's recipes using mystery basket ingredients inspired by her classic French dishes, the competitors use not only their culinary skills, but also their knowledge of what makes Julia Child so iconic. The chefs must live up to Julia Child's legacy while being judged by a rotating panel of judges including Scott Conant, Susan Feniger, Amanda Freitag, Alex Guarnaschelli, Nilou Motamed, Michael Voltaggio and, from the Max comedy series Julia, actress and author Isabella Rossellini.

name: Krishnas: Gurus. Karma. Murder.
summary: When an Indian Swami gives a lost generation of Americans a new message of love, the Hare Krishna religion is born. But when the Swami dies without finishing his mission, an American Guru tries to seize control of the movement, leading to accusations of racketeering and murder, and investigations by a West Virginia Sheriff's Detective, the LAPD and the FBI. Krishnas: Gurus. Karma. Murder. gives a glimpse into the epic American tale about charismatic personalities that offer divine light, and Krishna devotees who discover their movement has been corrupted by greed, lust for power and vengeance.

name: The Greatest TV...
summary: Over three two-hour episodes, this series looks at the greatest TV of the 1960s, 70s and 80s. Featuring classic archive, interviews with those involved in making these amazing TV shows, behind-the-scenes stories and pictures, and tributes from celebrity fans, Greatest TV looks at all genres - from soaps to sitcom, kids shows to music programming, stand-out dramas to epic live TV events.

name: Where Is Baby Gabriel?
summary: Gabriel Johnson, a baby missing since 2009, was last seen with his mother Elizabeth; this docuseries delves into the twists and deceit surrounding his disappearance in a search for the truth.

name: At Home with Genevieve
summary: Discover At Home with Genevieve Gorder. Gen spent years as a top design expert at HGTV. Now she will explore facets of her lifestyle with At Home With Genevieve.

name: Batalla en Abuela's Kitchen
summary: Up-and-coming Gen-Z cooks compete against each other in creating iconic Latin dishes for family gatherings. The winners who prove their skill will face-off against the kitchen's biggest boss: ABUELA!

name: Мужчина, который не хочет на мне жениться
Manden der forblændede alle
summary: Three part docu serie, about the fraudster 'Lars Nørholt', that tricks all into beliving the "bright" future of the  lightning company 'Hesalight', by making fraudilant orders.

name: Onze man bij de Taliban
summary: After the sudden departure of the Americans and their Western allies, almost all foreign journalists also left Afghanistan. Journalist Thomas Erdbrink and director Roel van Broekhoven decide to spend a few months in Kabul. In the four-part series Our Man in the Taliban, they experience how the new rulers are tightening the reins a little more every day.

name: Hitler's American Battleground
summary: During World War II, Nazi U-boats attacked several American ships along the North Carolina coast, turning this location into the graveyard of the Atlantic Ocean. Follow a group of marine archaeologists as they embark on an incredible mission, trying to honour those who lost their lives during the attacks, by turning this underwater battleground into a timeless memorial.

name: Moorddossier
summary: In each episode a striking Dutch murder case will be discussed. The murder files will be sift through by detectives, lawyers, family members and (former) suspects.

name: The Substitute Princess's Love
summary: The God of War, Wen Ye, died in battle on the eve of his wedding, and a nationwide mourning was held. The bride-to-be was the legitimate daughter of the Shen family. But Mrs. Shen was reluctant to let her daughter become a widow and feared the criticism that would come with a broken engagement. Thus, she found her estranged illegitimate daughter, Shen Keyi, who had been living in seclusion, and forced her to take her daughter's place in marriage. Due to a mistaken war report, Wen Ye returned victorious, and Shen Keyi, who had married into the Wang family, became the true princess. However, she and the prince developed a complex and spirited relationship, and during their journey, they ignited the sparks of love. After facing numerous challenges, they eventually understood the true essence of love and protection. In the end, they chose to be together, not seeking wealth and prosperity but only desiring a few moments of leisure that belonged to the two of them alone.

name: For the Kid I Saw in My Dreams
summary: 13 years ago, Nakajou Senri's parents were brutally murdered and his older twin brother Kazuto was taken away by a man with a ‘fire' scar on his arm. Since then, Senri has lived only for revenge. He continues to search for the ‘fire' man. Together with his childhood friend Enan and detective Wakazono, he attempts to track down the truth behind the incident and exact his revenge.

name: Un'estate fa
summary: Un'estate fa takes place on two temporal planes: the summer of 1990, when the tragic death of the teenager Arianna occurred, and the present, in which Elio, now a lawyer and family man, must face the past when Arianna's body, with whom he was in love, is found.

name: The Fragments of Kylin
summary: Mo Yan and Xuanyuan Yu has an arranged marriage for the alliance between their two great demon-slaying families. It is supposed to be a two-year superficial marriage, but Mo Yan discovers he has long fallen for her... With endless conflicts and hidden truths, can they truly be together?

name: What If
summary: A normal girl Xia Guo is faced with a difficult dilemma where the two choices will lead her toward two utterly different lives. Would she choose to live a home-sweet-home life with her boyfriend in her hometown or seize the opportunity to forge a successful career in a metropolitan? Which way would make her life "a little less normal"?

name: Chase the Truth
summary: Police detective Chu Yi Han goes undercover to infiltrate a criminal organization in hopes of finding his mother. By chance, he encounters Gu Lin Na.

name: Heroes
summary: The drama tells the story of a group of individuals with different backgrounds who were unexpectedly drawn into a mysterious treasure-hunting journey during the late Qing Dynasty. Amidst the grand and tumultuous historical tide, they gradually strengthened their ideals of saving the country.

name: Everlasting Longing
summary:
When the business prodigy meets a domineering man, their story begins. The eldest daughter of a merchant family has been living with two identities. To outsiders, Jun Qi Luo is Jun Fei Fan, the illegitimate son of the family. She was taken to Beixuan at the age of 20 years old.

Jun Qi Luo experiences many hardships in a foreign land. She is accused of being a spy, humiliated and mistreated. Qi Luo finds a chance to escape but discovers that while she is away from home, the prince has colluded with her brother-in-law and his mistress to steal their family fortune. Jun Qi Luo takes her aging father, erniang and two younger sisters with her as she fights to rebuild the family business.

name: Adventure behind the Bronze Door
summary: After telling the story of Tomb Robbing Notes, Wu Xie and Wang Fatty went to the Snow Mountain to explore Zhang Qiling's mysterious life experience. In the process, they fought with Zhang Haixing and Zhang Haike, brothers and sisters of the Zhang family, and got involved in an unprecedented conspiracy. This is the beginning of an exciting adventure.

name: My Demon
summary: A fantasy rom-com about the demon-like chaebol heiress Do Do Hee and the demon Jung Goo Won, who loses his powers one day, as they enter a contractual marriage.

name: Street Outlaws vs. the World
summary: The quickest and most polarizing Street Outlaws travel abroad to represent their country. As Team USA, they must face stiff, well-known competition from Australia to prove that they are, in fact, the world's fastest drivers.

name: 3FF
summary: After their adventure in Portugal, Leyla and Kyra are fully immersed in the labor market. This seems to work out well for Leyla, but for Kyra, finding the dream job becomes a more difficult quest. Amber is still halfway through student life. She has not yet graduated but is working hard on her thesis.

name: Hot Mess Summer
summary:
Eight party-loving Brits, all a liability on a night out, are challenged to spend the summer on the other side of the bar-running one of Zante's busiest party spots.

The eight hedonists all think they're coming for a summer of fun, but have really been nominated by their friends-who are sick of their antics on nights out-to successfully run the bar at the height of holiday season, doing everything from mixing cocktails to cleaning toilets. If they can work together and resist temptation they could share a big cash prize. But that's easier said than done for these hilarious Hot Messes.

name: Huse med hemmeligheder
summary: This series aims to investigate the architectural and historic background of buildings that is being renovated.

name: The Next Marijuana Millionaire
summary: Sixteen budding entrepreneurs compete for a grand prize worth up to $1 Million and a partnership with Cannabis Icon Michael "BigMike" Straumietis.

name: Game Changer Lovers
summary: Mingya, a gaming VP, time-travels with a magical chip necklace. Guided by the spiritual realm's "Wanqi," she realizes her college crush, Bei Su, is her mission target. This drama fuses Infinite Flow, ancient, and sci-fi elements as they battle evil forces.

name: Sultan of Delhi
summary: A survivor of Partition becomes the rising force of Delhi's underworld. As a new leader emerges, a ruthless game of power, betrayal and politics begins.

name: Słoneczna włócznia
summary: Mateusz, the father of 12-year-old Max, is a scientist, physicist - participating in the expedition of a team of archaeologists conducting excavations in the Andes. Max, who goes beyond mediocrity with his knowledge, is not liked by his schoolmates, especially since he is a new student in the class. His only friend is Matilda, as crazy as Max, nicknamed the 'Wild'. Mateusz finds a mysterious object in the Andes - a solar spear, emitting unusual, as it will turn out, extraterrestrial radiation.

name: Uga uga
summary: Nikos searches for his grandson Adriano, raised by Pajé since he was a child. Adriano/Tatuapu's fate intersects with that of Baldochi, who fakes his death to protect Maria João and her family.

name: Tell Me More with Kelly Corrigan
summary: Author Kelly Corrigan talks with influential leaders.

name: Justifiable Defence
summary: Veteran prosecutor Duan Hongshan of the Municipal Procuratorate is assigned to handle a case involving a woman who killed her husband after suffering domestic abuse. Fang Lingyuan, a young prosecutor from the Provincial Procuratorate, is appointed to assist with the investigation. During their investigation, they discover the case's close ties to a "campus excessive self-defense case" from fourteen years ago, which involved Li Mufeng, Mei Zheng, and Jiang Ting. It was also an earlier case handled by Duan Hongshan. Guided by facts and the rule of law, and carefully weighing moral principles, human sentiment, and national law, the two work together to arrive at an accurate and fair legal conclusion.

name: Street Legal
summary: A fast-paced drama series focusing on the lives of the partners of the law firm Wyeth & Associated in Auckland, New Zealand, run by Peter Wyeth. The main character David Silesi is a maverick lawyer who pushes the limits of the law. He will do anything for his clients and friends. He also spends most of the series pining for his law partner Joni Collins. Collins is a level-headed female lawyer at Wyeth & Associates. In its third series, Silesi and Collins join together and buy out the firm to save it after Wyeth dies in unfortunate circumstances.

name: The Holiday Shift
summary: The Holiday Shift is a five-episode romantic comedy series following the intersecting love stories of young mall employees during the holiday season.

name: Die Quellen des Bösen
summary: In 1993, a girl's body was found on a bed of flowers in a forest, covered in mysterious runes. The East German commissioner Ulrike Bandow and her new colleague Koray Larssen take over the case. Mysterious clues lead the investigative duo into the German-German past to an undiscovered, bizarre series of murders - which apparently hasn't ended yet. The investigators' cruel assumption is that the perpetrator has returned to the place where it all began. In order to stop him, the unlikely investigators have to learn to trust each other. But Larssen has an agenda of her own and Bandow is confronted with her past while solving the case...

name: The Future Chicken Today Show
summary:
In the year 2050, the BioBarn (half TV Studio/ half Planet Protector HQ), is abuzz with activity. Using their time-twister portal, hosts Potato, Frittata, and Rocket Pants present a live-streamed show from the future to engage kids in 2023. This monthly event, known as The Future Chicken Today Show, is a dynamic ECO-TAINMENT series featuring lively interviews with notable guests who provide inspiring yet honest perspectives on the global environment. Cutting-edge technology allows for interviews conducted by the world's FIRST animated chicken host. 

Tune in 'live' from 2050 as our hosts showcase a new video game, celebrate ‘Chicken Appreciation Day', and interview guests from the 2020s who 'time-twist' to the studio to offer solutions, share planet-protecting advice, and join the fun. The show introduces wildlife conservationists, gaming influencers, climate scientists, eco-activists, and more, fostering inspiration and humor to empower kids with a positive outlook on the future. The Future Chicken Today Show represents a groundbreaking era in live streaming!

name: Wild Cards
summary: Wild Cards follows the unlikely duo of a gruff, sardonic cop and a spirited, clever con woman. Ellis, a demoted detective, has unfortunately spent the last year on the maritime unit, while Max has been living a transient life elaborately scamming everyone she meets. But when Max gets arrested and ends up helping Ellis solve a local crime, the two are offered the opportunity to redeem themselves, with Ellis going back to detective and Max staying out of jail. The catch? They have to work together, with each using their unique skills to solve crimes. For Ellis, that means hard-boiled shoe leather police work; for Max, it means accents, schemes and generally befriending everyone in sight, while driving Ellis absolutely nuts. Against the backdrop of beautiful Vancouver — with all its unique, charming, and even contradictory neighbourhoods and subcultures — the two will have to learn what it means to trust another person and maybe actually become partners.

name: Sight Unseen
summary: Homicide detective Tess Avery is forced to quit the job she loves after nearly killing her partner and being diagnosed as clinically blind. Reluctant to accept help, Tess uses an assistance app and connects with Sunny Patel, a professional seeing-eye guide and agoraphobe living 3,000 miles away. Haunted by the unsolved cases she left behind, Tess uses a hidden camera and earpiece, while Sunny remotely steers Tess through life's obstacles -- and crimes -- as the two challenge preconceptions about ability, trust and where to draw the line.

name: Les Revoltes
summary: Éléonore St-Laurent is a lawyer of convictions and arguments. Jacob Gravel-Duquette is an investigative journalist and follows his instincts no matter where they lead him. Each in their own way, sometimes by joining forces, they denounce the flaws of the system, supporting individuals revolted by the slowness or rigidity of institutions. Through their fight against institutional absurdities, Éléonore and Jacob help these desperate individuals obtain a semblance of justice.

name: Animanimals
summary: Animanimals is a multi award winning series without dialogue where, in each episode, a different animal has an absurd adventure that can only happen to him.

name: Spooky Files
summary:
When supernatural creatures – nicknamed ‘Spookies' - start appearing in the small Australian town of Sunny Valley, long-time Spookyphile Bert is thrilled. He assembles the ‘Spooky Crew,' consisting of his best bud and gadget queen Xena, his super-cool sorta step-sis Billie, and Derek, their school's sports captain - an ‘undercover agent' who keeps his Spooky beliefs a secret. Their mission: to capture the ‘Spookies,' figure out where they're coming from, and safely return them ‘home' – wherever that may be!

The series blends contemporary characters and retro delights from the 80s and 90s with mystery, humour, nostalgia and just the right amount of scary. Each episode features a new Spooky surprise, from a humungous flying clown head to a punk rock truth fairy and even a Fart Blob.

name: Le Temps Des Framboises
summary: Elizabeth inherits the family farm following her husband's death, who had concealed that he was gravely ill. Taking on the immense task of a novice now running the whole operation, she plunges headlong into this new and unpredictable life.

previousepisode.name: Le ciel à portée de mains

name: CBS Saturday Morning
summary: Hosts Jeff Glor, Dana Jacobson and Michelle Miller provide original reporting, breaking news, and profiles of leading figures in culture and the arts from the Times Square studio on the Saturday edition of the CBS morning news family.

previousepisode.name: Karina Rykman, Fabio Trabocchi, Stavros Halkias

name: Women Wearing Shoulder Pads
summary: Women Wearing Shoulder Pads, which follows a wealthy Spaniard living in Ecuador as she journeys through the complicated world of love, family, commercials, and cuyes, a.k.a. South American guinea pigs. The new series will mark Adult Swim's first-ever Spanish-language series along with its return to the stop-motion animation format.

name: Street Outlaws: Farmtruck and AZN Down Under
summary: What would a trip to Australia be like without the antics and fishin' of Farmtruck and AZN? It would be a lot less fun, that's what. Farmtruck and AZN head to the land down under as well and find their own races and fun antics in a complete fish out of water racing series.

name: Trauma Room One
summary:
Trauma Room One features extreme surgery like no other, where death is just one millimetre away. The series takes us deep inside the gripping, high-stakes world of brain and spinal surgery at The Walton Centre in Liverpool which treats more than 18,000 patients a year.

The team of highly specialised surgeons work around the clock to save and transform patients' lives. From major trauma emergencies to life-altering operations, Trauma Room One puts us on the frontline of life-saving surgeries. But beware… it's not for the faint-hearted.

name: Police 999: Clear & Present Danger
summary: Fasten your seatbelt as this series takes you into the heart of the action, where frontline police officers are risking their lives to keep Britain safe. With unprecedented access to shocking police body-worn camera footage, we step into the shoes of heroic officers fighting crime and tackling some of the country's most violent and dangerous criminals.

name: Border Protection Spain
summary: The Spanish Coastguard are a team of elite professionals who risk their lives daily to protect the 8,000 kilometres of Spanish coastline. We follow these brave men and women who fight to intercept drug smugglers, human traffickers and illegal poachers. The team are also on call day and night to launch rescue missions to those in peril.

name: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Meals
summary: It's goodbye long shopping lists and hello all-new easy, clever recipes, as Jamie Oliver shows us how to create deliciously flavoursome dishes using just five hero ingredients.

name: Alle mod 1
summary: Weekly competition/game-show where contesters are competing to win up to 100'000dkr, in a series of experiments, where it's all about who can be nearest in their guess, the one vs the many?

name: Loppen & lærlingen
summary: Show about the two 'recycling experts', that on each episode get a new 'apprentice', on their team, where they will have to guide the apprentice in buying low, restoration, and selling high.

name: Shi Cha Hai
summary: On three generations of the Zhuang family who live in a Shicha Hai Hutong in central Beijing.

name: Золотой телёнок
summary: A screen adaptation of the cult novel by Ilya Ilf and Evgeny Petrov, including fragments that were not previously published for censorship reasons. The story of Bender's hunt for the underground millionaire Koreiko develops in the 20s of the last century. Bright characters, adventurous adventures and a light veil of a bygone era in a new version of a classic work of Soviet literature.

name: The Princess Royal
summary: In the story, Li Rong, the Princess Royal of the Great Xia Dynasty, and Pei Wenxuan, the Senior Grand Secretary, go through a wonderful time. They turn from enemies to bosom friends, and then lovers. They trust each other and help each other to fulfill their wishes. Finally, they get back together, work together, and discover the truth and love together

name: Love of the Divine Tree
summary: This drama is an adaptation of the novel of the same name by the popular author Kuang Shang Jia Kuang on Jinjiang. Su Yishui, a talented young cultivator, had his destiny changed by his master Mu Qingge eighteen years ago. Mu Qingge, known as the "female demon," was also branded with a bad reputation and presumed dead. Eighteen years later, Mu Qingge transforms into Xue Ranran, and Su Yishui, now the head of the West Mountain Sect, takes the critically ill Ranran as his disciple, vowing to protect her for life. Thus, the roles of master and disciple are swapped, and various amusing and unusual stories unfold between them.

name: Einsatz Hamburg Süd
summary: German Carla Simon and Turkish Sema Aslan work as detectives in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg. They may be very different, but they make a good team. Her boss is Richard Wohmann, her colleagues include Doris Schelling and Bernie Ziegler. Later Frauke Hansen comes to the station. Sema's friend is initially Jürgen, later Thomas.

name: El vuelo del águila
summary: A military hero in the Reform Wars, Porfirio Diaz was also one of the strategists behind the overthrow of the empire by Republicans. Several times he tried to attain power through military coups, but was defeated until a last revolt in 1876 took him to the Presidency of the Republic. Except for a short period of four years, he governed until 1911, when a takeover by Francisco I. Madero forced him into exile. He lived long enough to see his revolution fall apart and all of his gains destroyed by his own lengthy stay in power. As a hero or sly weaver of intrigues, Porfirio Diaz learns, fights, plots, governs, kills, pacificies, loves, suffers, cries, devotes himself to his work and does not abandon it until his own people rise up to expel him.

name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse
summary: As a prophecy of doom unfolds on the peaceful land of Britannia, a purehearted boy sets out on a journey of discovery — and revenge.

name: Suraj Aur Saanjh
summary: Facing depression after her recent divorce, Saanjh has to host her younger sister's boss Suraj. Unruly and ill-mannered Suraj enters Saanjh's already messed up life and turns it upside down.

name: La España de Clemente
summary: After Spain did not qualify for the final phase of the 1992 Euro Cup, the Spanish Football Federation appointed Javier Clemente as national coach. A coach, the one from Barakaldo, who had just won two Leagues with Athletic Bilbao and led Espanyol to the UEFA final. A lover of English football, the new coach puts together a physical and brave team that is the opposite of the beauty of Johan Cruyff's Barça that was beginning to set a trend at that time. Beyond styles and after an agonizing match against Denmark, Spain made it to the 1994 World Cup in the United States and for the first time in a long time it is being talked about as one of the favorites to lift the title.

name: The Other Mrs Jordan – Catching the Ultimate Conman
summary: Mary Turner Thomson had grown used to her husband's frequent and often sudden trips away to far-flung locations as well as the secretive nature of his work, which meant he was regularly unable to maintain contact with her. She convinced herself that these challenges were a necessary sacrifice when your spouse, William Allen Jordan, was a CIA agent working in counter terrorism in the early 2000s. Or so she thought, until a fateful phone call in April 2006 from someone saying she was "The Other Mrs Jordan" blew her world apart.

name: Britain's Housing Crisis: What Went Wrong?
summary: Britain's housing market is broken. With spiralling prices and record rents, key figures reveal the roots of the crisis. How did we get here - and what could happen next?

name: Outriders
summary: A group of teenagers, living in the middle of a national park where they teach how to ride horses endeavor upon mysteries and adventures.

name: GBRB: Reap What You Sow
summary: Korea's renowned celebrities who are best friends in real life, venture away from the urban hustle and bustle to a remote 'FARM,' taking part in an organic harvest challenge and relishing the joys of countryside living. They will do daily tasks like real-life harvesting, while also indulging in lighthearted, impromptu games. This show offers viewers a glimpse into rural life and the efforts required to cultivate crops from seed to harvest.

name: Вызов
summary: A group of professional Moscow investigators, consisting of three people - Alexei Khromov, his assistant and a favorite of women, in combination Igor Lyamin and forensic expert Olga Barysheva - specializes in solving mysterious crimes ...

previousepisode.name: Nog nooit zo verbonden, nog nooit zo alleen

name: E6 – En reise gjennom nordmenns hverdag
summary:
The E6 is Norway's main road, stretches through the entire country and is 2,762 kilometers long.
Program leader Truls Svendsen wants to get to know the people who live, work and travel along the road better and decides to drive the distance in a motorhome.

The trip goes from Svinesund to Kirkenes, and on its way, Truls meets Ted the vacuum cleaner salesman, Marit the postwoman, Rigmor the trailer driver, Terje the vet, Ronald the shaman and many more.

name: Ireland's Most Evil Killers
summary:
Ireland's Most Evil Killers delves into the sordid world of some of the most notorious murderers the country has ever seen.

The gripping five-part series examines the disturbing cases of five of Ireland's most infamous killers: Joe O'Reilly, Colin Whelan, Catherine Nevin, Charlotte and Linda Mulhall, and Eric Locke.

name: Stay Young Stay Passion
summary:
The story opens with the failed uprising in 1927. Foshan Communist Party members Chen and his wife died tragically to provide cover for their comrades. Years later, their three children go on to make spectacular achievements in the field of Cantonese medicine, cuisine and opera to earn fame in all of Guangzhou, staying true to their intentions even in wartime.

Due to the drastic countermeasures against the revolutionaries in Guangzhou on April 15, 1927, CCP underground members Chen and his wife died heroically and their three children were adopted by ordinary people. The eldest son Chen Shan He becomes an apprentice of medicine, the second son Chen Qing Wei becomes a chef, and the youngest daughter Chen Li Xia becomes an opera performer. Under the tutelage of their respective masters, they become legends in their own fields.

Just as they are about to take revenge on the enemy who killed their parents, war breaks out in Guangzhou causing the fates of the three individuals to also change dramatically. Chen Shan He engages in a seven-year struggle with Japanese merchants to protect the secrets of traditional Chinese medicine. He also devotes everything in the deadly fight against Japan's biological weapons.

Chen Qing Wei refuses to betray his country so he leaves for Hong Kong to promote Cantonese cuisine. He returns to Guangzhou with a successful career and helps his brother in their efforts to save the people. Chen Li Xia leads the performance troupe during the war, continuing to improve her craft and learning to find a balance between their harsh reality and the beautiful world of opera. The three siblings adhere to their national integrity amidst the severe trials of war to pass on their respective skills.

name: Playboyy
summary: When sex brings mysteries needed to be solved, a group of friends go explore the wicked world of young adults, expose shady business and discover their deepest darkest desires through chaotic sex and relationships.

name: The Princess is a Rabbit Fairy
summary: Bai Zaizai, a Rabbit fairy, to get revenge for her master, accidentally broke into the palace and became the bodyguard of Liu Changge, the second prince. The two of them were in the process of getting along, from knowing each other to slowly falling in love. Liu Changge helped Bai Zaizai complete the revenge for her master, and Bai Zaizai also helped Liu Changge defeat the national master Shen Yi and other princes in the dangerous palace.

name: The Vietnam War
summary: This series tells the story of the Vietnam War, from the country's dynastic history, the impact of Christian missionaries & French colonialism, Japan's invasion during WWII and the rise of Ho Chi Minh. How the US's fear of communism created a sequence of events that caused American troops to go in and the nation found itself entwined in a war.

name: Vietnam: The War That Made Australia
summary: The Australian Army Training Team fought shoulder-to-shoulder with the South Vietnamese Army during the Vietnam War. The Team was Australia's first unit to enter the war, advising the South Vietnamese forces and working alongside the CIA to raise an indigenous guerrilla force. With many telling their stories for the first time, they bear the physical and psychological scars of that combat.

name: My Dear Gangster Oppa
summary: Guy is a college nerd who's secretly in love with his best friend Whan. To relieve his loneliness of the one-sided love, Guy's hobby is playing games. It's in a game that Guy meets a kind sister named Yuri who he later discovers is a handsome young mafioso named Tiw. While Guy starts to open his heart due to Tiw's gentleness, he gets to know Tiw's mysterious and terrifying past. Who Guy will choose? Whan, the only best friend he has known since childhood or Tiw the young mafia boss who is in danger?

name: The Bannen Way
summary: A slick, sexy, action-packed show about Neal Bannen, a charming con-man with a police chief for a father, a mob boss for an uncle and a weakness for beautiful women, who wants to turn his life around and leave the criminal lifestyle forever.

name: Front and Center
summary: Front and Center is the critically-acclaimed concert series that was launched in the Spring of 2012. The original one hour, commercial-free, all-music program airs nationwide on public television. Through the years it has presented an eclectic mix of Grammy winning, multi-platinum selling industry vets and chart toppers, including the likes of Jack Johnson, Train, The Avett Brothers, Cyndi Lauper, the Goo Goo Dolls and more.

name: Romeo and His Butterfly Lover
summary: In some faraway place, the Laws and the Chuks are two big families that have been foes for a century as they can never stand each other. In a chance encounter, the Law Family's fourth son Law Mak-au falls head over heels in love with Chu Lai-yip, who is the younger cousin sister of the Chuk Family's matriarch Chuk Ying-kiu. Lai-yip already has a finacé. If her marriage eventually falls through, Ying-kiu's status as the chair will be affected. However, due to some past event about herself, Ying-kiu resolutely decides to let Lai-yip make her own choice, sowing the seeds of a duel between the two families. In the meantime, Leung Shan-pak adopts Max Ton as his name and lives in Hoi Pak City, which is the Law Family's territory. To avoid assassins, he goes to the Chuk Family's Tin Nam City and then the mysterious Zone 8. He again runs into two women who were seemingly associated with him.

name: Een Grote Familie
summary:
Mother Julia moves into her new boyfriend Taco's house together with her 2 daughters Mies and Kees and son Guus. Taco also has 2 daughters (Zimbini and Lotus) from his previous marriage with Moon, and a son (Max) from a relationship before his first marriage. 
That is a big change for everybody in this newly "put toghether" family. How do you handle different parenting styles, different norms and vallues, frustration, sadness over a divorce and the new bonus family members ?
And to make matters even worse for Julia, her ex husband Dennis who was absent most of the marriage because he chose his work over his family, now decides he has to be there for the kids, and buys the houseboat directly opposite the street from Taco's house.

name: La caza: nada es lo que parece
Sun, Sea and Scalpels
summary: Following the mixed fortunes of Irish cosmetic & medical tourists jetting off to the sun to go under the knife.

name: Unser Hof - Mit Cheyenne und Nino
summary: Country life with two children, lots of animals and big plans: Cheyenne Ochsenknecht and Nino Sifkovits open the gates to their farm in Styria.

name: Das Blut der Templer
summary: 18-year old David grew up assuming that his mother and his father have died when he was a baby. He was raised by a monk and is close to completing High School. He gets into a fight during a party and discovers he is stronger than he thought he was- also, the blooding of an injury stops immediately and the wound heals within an hour. All of a sudden, the Priory of Sion and the Knights Templar show interest in the boy and the quest for the Holy Grail begins once again, with David being the one who can lead them to it.

name: Vikings: American Quest
summary: A crew of experts and volunteers work on constructing the largest recreation of a Viking ship ever in order to sail it across the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Sálvese quien pueda
summary: After 14 successful years of "Sálvame" on Spanish TV, Belén Esteban, Lydia Lozano, Terelu Campos, Kiko Hernández, María Patiño, Kiko Matamoros, Chelo García-Cortés and Víctor Sandoval look for new job opportunities across America in this reality series.

name: Angels Fall Sometimes
